column.name: report_sql
column.value: SELECT i.fec_emi AS fh_emision, 4 AS clase_documento, i.tipo_dte AS tipo_documento, NULL AS numero_resolucion, NULL AS numero_serie, NULL AS numero_control_interno_del, MAX(i.codigo_generacion) AS numero_documento_al, MIN(i.codigo_generacion) AS numero_documento_del, NULL AS numero_documento_del_1, NULL AS numero_documento_al_1, NULL AS numero_registradora, SUM(COALESCE(s.total_exenta, 0)) AS ventas_exentas, 0.0 AS ventas_internas_nosuj, SUM(COALESCE(s.total_no_suj, 0)) AS ventas_no_sujetas, SUM(COALESCE(s.total_gravada, 0)) AS ventas_gravadas_locales, 0.0 AS exportacion_dentro_centroamerica, 0.0 AS exportacion_afuera_centroamerica, 0.0 AS exportaciones_servicios, 0.0 AS venta_zona_franca, SUM(COALESCE(s.total_exenta, 0) + COALESCE(s.total_no_suj, 0) + COALESCE(s.total_gravada, 0)) AS total_ventas, COALESCE(i.tipo_operacion, 4) AS tipo_operacion, 2 AS tipo_ingreso, 2 AS anexo FROM m_invoice i LEFT JOIN m_invoice_summary s ON s.invoice_id = i.id LEFT JOIN m_loan_transaction lt ON lt.id = i.loan_transaction_id LEFT JOIN m_savings_account_transaction sat ON sat.id = i.savings_transaction_id LEFT JOIN m_client_transaction ct ON ct.id = i.client_transaction_id WHERE i.status IN ('SUBMITTED', 'ACCEPTED') AND i.fec_emi >= '${startDate}' AND i.fec_emi <= '${endDate}' AND (${officeId} = -1 OR COALESCE(lt.office_id, sat.office_id, ct.office_id) = ${officeId}) GROUP BY i.fec_emi, i.tipo_dte, COALESCE(i.tipo_operacion, 4) ORDER BY i.fec_emi, i.tipo_dte

column.name: description
column.value: Anexo Facturacion mensual agrupado por dia para DTE
